sentences[3].whyEn: schlechthin — AFTER the noun: the epitome.

sentences[15].whyEn: durchaus — a concession before the aber.
help.tips[0].examples[0].en: The plan is certainly sensible but by no means mature – and not exactly cheap.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: A settlement is better any day than a lawsuit; we wouldn’t have time for it anyway.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: keineswegs flatly denies: by no means justified. durchaus affirms, and nicht gerade only means 'not exactly'.
help.tips[0].en.text: durchaus berechtigt (certainly – against an expected doubt) · keineswegs / keinesfalls / mitnichten sicher (by no means) · nicht gerade / nicht eben billig (not exactly – understated ‘expensive’) · allemal besser (better any day) · ohnehin / sowieso (anyway).
help.tips[0].en.title: Affirm and deny: durchaus / keineswegs, nicht gerade
help.tips[0].en.trap: durchaus alone affirms, durchaus nicht denies: „Das ist durchaus nicht sicher“ = keineswegs sicher. And durchaus is not ‘throughout’.
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: The performance was decidedly successful, the finale downright triumphant.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: For many this book is the big-city novel par excellence.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: 'Downright' is geradezu. gerade on its own means 'just now' or 'precisely', and durchaus means 'certainly'.
help.tips[1].en.text: geradezu / regelrecht / schlichtweg absurd (downright) · ausgesprochen / äußerst unfreundlich (decidedly) · überaus / ungemein fruchtbar (exceedingly, elevated) · regelrecht / förmlich begeistert (positively) · der Roman schlechthin (par excellence – after the noun).
help.tips[1].en.title: Intensify: geradezu, regelrecht, ausgesprochen, überaus, schlechthin
help.tips[1].en.trap: geradezu, not gerade: „gerade absurd“ means ‘just now absurd’ or ‘precisely absurd’, not ‘downright absurd’.
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: Admittedly the result is modest; at least it is a result – in a sense a beginning.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: I am reasonably satisfied with the compromise, even if it is not entirely new.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: immerhin salvages something positive: at least the breakfast was good. ohnehin means 'anyway', and keineswegs denies.
help.tips[2].en.text: gleichsam / gewissermaßen / sozusagen (as it were – marks a figurative claim) · einigermaßen / halbwegs / leidlich (reasonably) · nicht ganz / nicht völlig (not entirely) · immerhin / wenigstens / zumindest (at least) · zwar / freilich / gewiss … doch / aber (admittedly … but).
help.tips[2].en.title: Soften, salvage, concede
help.tips[3].examples[0].en: That is right. → certainly right / by no means right / not entirely right
help.tips[3].examples[1].en: The proposal is good. → exceedingly good / passably good
help.tips[3].check.whyEn: One shading word per claim sets its temperature; piling up two or three sounds mannered.
help.tips[3].en.text: Give every evaluative sentence exactly one: it sets the temperature of the judgement. Three in one sentence sound mannered.
help.tips[3].en.title: One shading word per claim
help.context.en: The new novel is certainly worth reading, but by no means the masterpiece the critics celebrate it as. The language is decidedly precise, the plot downright sparse – in a sense an experiment. Admittedly that won't please everyone; at least it never bores. For readers who have little time anyway, that is certainly an argument – and not exactly the worst.
help.mistakes[0].whyEn: durchaus nicht = keineswegs; the negation flips the meaning.
help.vocab[1].en: by no means / not at all (elevated)
help.hookEn: Set the exact temperature of every judgement with words like durchaus, keineswegs and geradezu, which English can only paraphrase.
help.introEn: Abtönung – shading the force of a statement – is what gives advanced German its precision of judgement, and it is done with adverbs that have no one-to-one English equivalent. Affirming against a doubt: durchaus, sehr wohl. Denying: keineswegs, keinesfalls, mitnichten (elevated), durchaus nicht, bei weitem nicht. Understating: nicht gerade, nicht eben. Intensifying: geradezu, regelrecht, schlichtweg (downright); ausgesprochen, überaus, äußerst, ungemein (decidedly, exceedingly); schlechthin / par excellence after the noun. Relativising: ohnehin, sowieso (anyway); allemal (any day). Softening: gleichsam, gewissermaßen, sozusagen (as it were); einigermaßen, halbwegs, leidlich (reasonably). Salvaging and conceding: immerhin, wenigstens, zumindest; zwar, freilich, gewiss … doch. In each of the seventeen sentences the English cue names the nuance; every adverb that expresses it in that context is accepted, so the drill is about the shade, not about guessing one word. They sit in the middle field before the word they shade (durchaus berechtigt, keineswegs sicher) – schlechthin follows its noun, and zwar, freilich, immerhin often stand in position 1.
help.rememberEn[0]: durchaus (certainly) / keineswegs, mitnichten (by no means) / geradezu, regelrecht (downright) / immerhin (at least) / freilich, zwar (admittedly) / schlechthin (par excellence, after the noun).
help.rememberEn[1]: Middle field, before the shaded word; zwar / freilich / immerhin may lead.
help.rememberEn[2]: durchaus nicht = keineswegs; nicht gerade / nicht eben = understatement.
